newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe down again before creditors meet.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe down again before creditors meet.

text.p: Polish construction company Espebepe SA fell 9.8 percent to 6.9 zlotys on Thursday, the day before its creditors meet to discuss a possible write- off of 75 million zlotys in debt, traders said.
The stock had fallen the daily maximum 10 percent on Wednesday after a bankruptcy motion by one of the firm's 564 creditors.
On both days post-price-fixing selling was strong enough for investors to have their bids reduced.
"Whenever there's bad news concerning that firm there's a fall," one trader said.
The company's chief told Reuters late on Wednesday he was confident Espebepe would defeat the bankruptcy motion in court and that the Friday meeting would definitively determine the company's future.
The bourse has suspended Espebepe trade on Friday.
